description: GitCafe is a Git forge for hosting repositories and collaborating on code. It provides repository browsing, issues, pull requests, reviews, and related account and integration workflows.
summary: GitCafe exposes a REST API at `https://git.cafe/api`, an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://git.cafe/mcp`, and an official `cafe` CLI distributed as `@gitcafe/cli` for Bun.
